title: Google\Cloud\Compute\V1\HttpHeaderAction
name: HttpHeaderAction
description: The request and response header transformations that take effect before the request is passed along to the selected backendService.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.request_headers_to_add
params.description: Headers to add to a matching request prior to forwarding the request to the backendService.

params.name: data.request_headers_to_remove
params.description: A list of header names for headers that need to be removed from the request prior to forwarding the request to the backendService.

params.name: data.response_headers_to_add
params.description: Headers to add the response prior to sending the response back to the client.

params.name: data.response_headers_to_remove
params.description: A list of header names for headers that need to be removed from the response prior to sending the response back to the client.

methods.name: getRequestHeadersToAdd
methods.description: Headers to add to a matching request prior to forwarding the request to the backendService.

methods.name: setRequestHeadersToAdd
methods.description: Headers to add to a matching request prior to forwarding the request to the backendService.

methods.name: getRequestHeadersToRemove
methods.description: A list of header names for headers that need to be removed from the request prior to forwarding the request to the backendService.

methods.name: setRequestHeadersToRemove
methods.description: A list of header names for headers that need to be removed from the request prior to forwarding the request to the backendService.

methods.name: getResponseHeadersToAdd
methods.description: Headers to add the response prior to sending the response back to the client.

methods.name: setResponseHeadersToAdd
methods.description: Headers to add the response prior to sending the response back to the client.

methods.name: getResponseHeadersToRemove
methods.description: A list of header names for headers that need to be removed from the response prior to sending the response back to the client.

methods.name: setResponseHeadersToRemove
methods.description: A list of header names for headers that need to be removed from the response prior to sending the response back to the client.
